instructions: Put the corn, still in its husk, on a plate and microwave it for 4 minutes. Let it cool for a few minutes while you chop.
Chop the romaine hearts into bite-size pieces and divide the lettuce among 4 bowls. Dice the tomatoes and scatter them over the lettuce.
Shred or dice the cooked chicken and divide it among the bowls.
Stand each ear of corn on its end and cut the kernels off with a knife. Add the kernels to the bowls.
Drizzle 1/4 cup of the barbecue sauce over the 4 salads, then 1/3 cup of the dairy-free ranch.
method_notes: Only the Skinnytaste version could be read (4.91 from 10 votes, so the fallback applies). It dresses romaine, tomato, corn and chicken with a drizzle of barbecue sauce and ranch. It cooks raw chicken breast; this version uses leftover or rotisserie chicken, as the dish promises. Bottled ranch is dairy, so the list calls for dairy-free ranch, and the barbecue sauce should be one labeled gluten-free. Other BBQ chicken salads add black beans, avocado or tortilla strips, which this one leaves out.
